label: Bible Study
prompt: Blow ye the _____ in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
verse: Blow ye the trumpet in Zion, and sound an alarm in my holy mountain: let all the inhabitants of the land tremble: for the day of the LORD cometh, for it is nigh at hand;
note: Joel's alarm — the trumpet in Zion, warning that the day of the LORD is near.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: How goodly are thy _____, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
verse: How goodly are thy tents, O Jacob, and thy tabernacles, O Israel!
note: Hired to curse Israel, Balaam looks down at their camp and blesses it instead: how goodly are thy tents!

label: Sunday School
prompt: And ere the _____ of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;
verse: And ere the lamp of God went out in the temple of the LORD, where the ark of God was, and Samuel was laid down to sleep;
note: Before the lamp of God went out, young Samuel was asleep in the temple — and about to hear his name called.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be _____; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
verse: For there is nothing hid, which shall not be manifested; neither was any thing kept secret, but that it should come abroad.
note: Spoken right after the lamp-under-a-bushel saying: what's hidden now is only waiting for daylight.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: And I will rebuke the _____ for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
verse: And I will rebuke the devourer for your sakes, and he shall not destroy the fruits of your ground; neither shall your vine cast her fruit before the time in the field, saith the LORD of hosts.
note: Bring the tithes, and God will 'rebuke the devourer' — no more crops lost before harvest. The promise right after the storehouse.
